name: Body Modifications Veteran
body:
You are so used to body modifications that you hardly even notice them.

Prerequisite(s): Con 15, Body Modifications Expert.

Benefit(s): You no longer need to succeed at a Fortitude save to avoid infection whenever you have a new body modification installed. The maximum number of body modifications you may have installed is equal to your Constitution modifier + 2 (minimum 2).

Normal: You must succeed at a Fortitude save to avoid infection when a new body modification is installed.
